bullets: Modeling primitives. Define the foundational concepts used to represent models, including objects, relationships, inputs, calculations, outputs, components, dimensions, measures…
Model structure and composition. Enable customers and product teams to construct sophisticated models from reusable, composable pieces rather than bespoke product-specific logic.
State and planning concepts. Establish consistent ways to represent concepts such as actuals, forecasts, versions, and scenarios across modeling use cases.
Cross-model interoperability. Define how data, assumptions, calculations, and outputs can be shared and referenced across models and products.
Modeling interfaces and contracts. Partner with Engineering to define clear schemas, APIs, behaviors, and guarantees that product teams can reliably build upon.
Own the long-term vision and strategy for compliance, identity, and authorization across the CaptivateIQ platform
Translate company, customer, and regulatory needs into a clear, prioritized product roadmap
Anticipate future scale, enterprise, and ecosystem requirements, and incorporate them into long-term platform investments
